records.title: MR. Video: "MapReduce" is the Principle for Long Video Understanding
records.reason: Primary source identity mismatch prevents abstract or full-text verification; preserve as borderline until the canonical source is resolved.

records.title: MegaSynth: Scaling Up 3D Scene Reconstruction with Synthesized Data
records.reason: The contribution scales 3D scene reconstruction training through synthetic geometric scenes and evaluates reconstruction/generalization. Its learned system is a vision reconstruction model, not language generation or an LLM inference method; the Jamba citation is only a broad model-family connection.

records.title: Maximize Your Data's Potential: Enhancing LLM Accuracy with Two-Phase Pretraining
records.reason: The two-phase data mixture/order changes LLM pretraining to improve accuracy. It provides no change to deployed decoding, serving, or inference resource use, and the Jamba citation does not establish a connection to an inference optimization method.

records.title: Toward Edge General Intelligence via Large Language Models: Opportunities and Challenges
records.reason: Survey discusses SLM routing, resource efficiency, latency, and offloading but offers no single new measured serving method; retain as a map for concrete edge-routing work.

records.title: FlooNoC: A 645-Gb/s/link 0.15-pJ/B/hop Open-Source NoC With Wide Physical Links and End-to-End AXI4 Parallel Multistream Support
records.reason: Hardware design/results cover network bandwidth, latency, area, timing, and energy; no LLM accelerator or inference workload is evaluated, though the linked memory-wall/quantization lineage makes it a weak hardware lead.
